# @vllnt/convex-progression

> TypeScript Convex component for gamification: XP totals, levels from your own thresholds, and activity streaks over days, weeks or any period you define.

Install `@vllnt/convex-progression` (builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; Node.js `>=20`. Mount it with
`app.use(config)` from `@vllnt/convex-progression/convex.config` and call it
through `new Progression(components.progression)` from host mutations and
queries. It stores one sandboxed `progress` table, one row per
`(scope, subjectRef, key)`: `xp`, `level`, `streak`, `maxStreak`,
`lastPeriodKey`, `updatedAt`. Methods: `accrue` adds XP and stores `level`, the
count of host `thresholds` the XP has reached; `recordActivity` records a host
`periodKey` (same period: streak unchanged; stored period equals
`expectedPrevious`: streak + 1; otherwise the streak restarts at 1); `get`
returns the state or `null` and recomputes `level` when `thresholds` are passed;
`reset` deletes one row; `eraseSubject` deletes a subject's rows in one scope in
batches (default 200, clamped to 500) and schedules the next pass when a batch
is full. Invalid input throws `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_REF`,
`INVALID_DELTA`, `INVALID_THRESHOLDS`, `INVALID_BATCH`, `XP_OVERFLOW` or
`STREAK_OVERFLOW`. Refs are 1..256 characters; `get` returns `null` for invalid
refs instead of throwing. `accrue` is not event-idempotent, periods are opaque
and unordered, and erase has no write fence: the host owns auth, the refs,
`delta`, `thresholds`, period keys, award deduplication and ordering. The only
client option is `defaultScope` (default `"global"`).
`@vllnt/convex-progression/test` exports `register(t, name = "progression")`
for `convex-test`. There is no leaderboard, calendar logic or React entry.

## When to use

- Use it when users earn XP and their level is how many of your XP thresholds
  they have reached.
- Use it when you count a streak of consecutive periods (days, weeks) per user.
- Use it when one user needs several separate tracks, such as one per game mode
  or course (`key`), optionally split by tenant (`scope`).
- Do not use it when the value is spent or transferred (coins, credits): use
  `@vllnt/convex-wallet`.
- Do not use it when an allowance resets on a schedule: use
  `@vllnt/convex-quota`.
- Do not use it when you need leaderboards or ranks: use `@convex-dev/aggregate`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at
`node_modules/@vllnt/convex-progression/docs/API.md` and match the installed
version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing code. The links below
to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.
